svg.title: Mockup 09: the next event in a series (superadmin)
svg.text: 09 · The next event: a series, its events, and one form that makes the next one (superadmin)
The tenants contract's series and clone: the superadmin creates the draft (it needs a hostname and a venue); its event admins then copy from the last event (mockup 10).
Use case: after an event, the superadmin opens the series and creates the next event with the last one's dates shifted, its venue and its admins
A · Series at 1280 px: master–detail, the series' events newest first
At Demo Hall, about every 16 weeks · 4 events
Clone the last event: each event admin of both events copies on the new event's
hostname; the series keeps its Discord server, its own bot moves along (bot.md).
B · New event in Demo LAN: filled from the last one
Filled from Demo Event, the series' last. Created as a draft.
Offered: the same weekday, 16 weeks after the last (D17)
Player One · admin of Demo Event
Player Three · admin of Demo Event
Only admins of both events can copy from the last one.
The draft is out of sight: guests see nothing, nobody joins.
Its admins get the event's link and a "Start from the last
event" card on its Health page (C, and mockup 10).
C · The new draft, for its event admin

g.text: Copy Demo Event's run of show,

svg.text: 1 · The series is the superadmin's (U11): a hostname and a venue are theirs to give. 2 · Every field is filled from the last event; the dates keep the weekday (D17). 3 · The new event's admins are led to the copy (U12–U14).
